versions.subject: rule: Mustang Panda dropper
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine: 
        - '*Temp\wtask.exe /create*'
        - '*%windir:~-3,1%%PUBLIC:~-9,1%*'
        - '*/E:vbscript * C:\Users\*.txt" /F'
        - '*/tn "Security Script *'
        - '*%windir:~-1,1%*'
selection2:
    Image:
        - '*Temp\winwsh.exe'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*Temp\\wtask.exe /create*", "*%windir:~-3,1%%PUBLIC:~-9,1%*", "*/E:vbscript * C:\\Users\*.txt\" /F", "*/tn \"Security Script *", "*%windir:~-1,1%*") OR Image="*Temp\\winwsh.exe"
